title: Review-qualified goal closure
description: Objective: close J1's remaining evidence-authority gap: goal.close currently trusts opaque caller-supplied verification/review witness refs. Deliverable: a daemon prerequisite composer that reads the exact durable EvidenceReceipt and ReviewOutputAccepted records for the candidate/result, binds their hashes and zero-authority proof into the core closure witness, and only then invokes the existing goal reducer/commit path. NOT in scope: new core rules, review-round persistence, verifier execution, UI, or canary tests. Depends on Durable verification receipt dispatch and the landed review persistence task task-9011e3b32c414e9ca0d49f49fdfaaf08. Owned paths: apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-services.ts, goal-services.test.ts, a focused goal-qualification.ts module, and apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-ledger.ts refusal vocabulary if required. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck.
definitionOfDone: goal.close derives its verification, review, result, and zero-authority witnesses from matching durable production records; request payload refs/truth labels alone cannot satisfy closure.

Missing receipt, non-passing/UNKNOWN receipt, mismatched result hash, absent ReviewOutputAccepted, stale review package, or remaining authority each refuse with a distinct stable daemon-prerequisite code/layer and commit nothing.
A fully matching verified/reviewed result closes the goal through the existing core reducer in the third J1 human action; no extra human command is introduced.
Replay is idempotent with one durable closure row, and earlier review/evidence records remain readable and byte-identical.
Focused daemon and repo typecheck gates exit 0; the worker mutation-drills the durable read rather than a request-field check.
taskRails: TDD every behavior change; every refusal test pins the exact stable reason code and refusing layer, and generated sweeps assert a positive case count.
Use only public package roots across package boundaries; no deep imports, test-owned authority, mock-backed acceptance, or optimistic UNKNOWN upgrades.
Keep production files focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; stage and commit only explicit owned paths.

comments.content:
Governor block-condition re-run 2026-08-13T22:25Z. TASK STAYS BLOCKED. Correcting a stale fact in the recorded reason.

The recorded block says the hard dependency task-44d4873e ("Durable verification receipt dispatch") "is PLANNING, not DONE" and adds "do NOT create a prerequisite — it already exists and is being planned now." That is no longer the situation: **task-44d4873e is now BLOCKED, not PLANNING.** Nobody is planning it. It is itself gated on task-6cbff010, task-8f9305b9 (this task) and task-97554aa4, all BLOCKED.

The "do not create a duplicate prerequisite" instruction still stands and is still correct — task-44d4873e exists and remains the right vehicle. What changed is that waiting for it to be "planned now" is no longer a live expectation; it will not move until its own chain clears.

Measured status of this task's four dependencies:
- task-9011e3b32c41 (review flow persistence) = DONE
- task-44d4873e = BLOCKED
- task-5e43a9e2 = BLOCKED
- task-97554aa4 = BLOCKED

No action available at this level. This task's unblock is downstream of the durable Claude attempt-dispatch chain, which currently traces back to task-311adb23 (WORKING) and task-c81953d2 (WORKING).

blockedReason: Fresh committed-HEAD audit confirms the hard dependency remains absent. Task task-44d4873eb9f746b1a978e97ff9743dc4 is now BLOCKED on task-6cbff010, not DONE. At HEAD 54af35270ca90a9f4d07c82e1896d9fb99c6b365, `git grep -n -E 'EvidenceReceipt|evidenceReceipt|foundation-verification' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src packages/store/src` returns zero production evidence-receipt/read-model hits. The review producer exists (`ReviewOutputAccepted` emitted at apps/daemon/src/review/review-acceptance.ts:119), but there is still no durable accepted-review reader, and goal.close continues to read `closureWitness`/`zeroAuthorityWitness` directly from request payload at goal-services.ts:80-92. Planning now would force this task to duplicate the verification receipt producer/read model owned by 44d or trust caller refs, both forbidden. Need task-44d QA-approved DONE with exact EvidenceReceipt and byte-identical read surface; then re-probe the matching ReviewOutputAccepted read path and create a separate prerequisite only if that reader is still absent. Do not duplicate 44d or narrow closure authority.
